summary: Offer prepared inline activation quantization for small MXFP8 projections
compatibility: Eligible SM120/SM121 plans can tune a fused_quantized alternative while retaining A16 and separate-quantization choices. Configuration and candidate identities change, requiring retuning.
details: Only declared capacities up to eight BF16 rows, unpadded K and N divisible by 64 and no wider than 4096 admit the fused variant.
Fused plans compile before execution, own exact partial-storage requirements and avoid activation staging. Large prefill capacities retain their existing workspace envelopes.
Quantized narrow deep-K capacities up to eight rows reserve room for up to eight ordered FP32 partials; prepared numerical and replay qualification are recorded separately.
